texts.at_approver_amount: Buza umuntu wesibili ngaphezu kwaleli nani
texts.at_approver_note: Futhi uma ushintsho luthinta izinto ezingaphezu kwezingu-{items}. Ocelayo akakaze aqinisekise isicelo sakhe.
texts.at_brief_note: Kuphela uma kukhona okufanele kushiwo, ngesikhathi osikhethayo, hhayi ngamahora athule.
texts.at_memory_note: Kugcinelwa leli bhizinisi kuphela. Akukaze kube izinombolo zekhadi, ama-PIN noma amakhodi. Akudayiswa, akwabiwa.
texts.at_never_secrets: Akugcinwanga: kubukeka njengenombolo yekhadi noma ikhodi.
texts.at_not_adviser: Ngichaza ngokujwayelekile. Angisiye ummeli, umgcinimafa noma umeluleki; ngingakuxhumanisa nomunye wabo.
texts.at_part_hidden: Ezinye izingxenye zifihliwe ngenxa yendima yakho.
texts.at_pause_note: Uma imisiwe, i-LynkAssist isaphendula kodwa ayishintshi lutho.
texts.at_plan_note: Isinyathelo ngasinye silinde ukuqinisekisa kwakho. Ungamisa uhlelo noma nini.
texts.at_roles_note: Akukaze kudlule lokho indima uqobo engakwenza.
texts.at_round_all: Yenza onke amanani abe inani eliphelele
texts.at_sample: Lokhu kushintsha izinto ezingu-{n}. Nazi ezingu-{shown}.
texts.at_second_approver: Lolu wushintsho olukhulu, ngakho umuntu wesibili uyaluqinisekisa: {role}.
texts.at_stopped_content_not_instructions: Lokhu kuvela embhalweni i-LynkAssist ewufundile, ngakho akwenziwa.
texts.at_stopped_paused: Izenzo ze-LynkAssist zimisiwe. Isaphendula, kodwa ayishintshi lutho.
texts.at_stopped_register: Lokhu kudinga umuntu noma ukuhlola okusheshayo kuqala.
texts.at_w_cash_mismatch: Imali ebaliwe ayihambisani nalokho okulindelwe yisitolo semali.
texts.at_w_duplicate_invoice: Le invoyisi ibukeka njengekhophi yaleyo osuyithumele.
texts.at_w_price_below_cost: Leli nani lingaphansi kwalokho okukubize khona ({cost}).
texts.at_w_stock_low: Lo mkhiqizo ungaphansi kwezinga lokuphinda u-ode.
